title: [Day 03] Full DOM snapshot with stable node ids and masking
text:
Part 1 is in. `Mirror` assigns ids from 1 and never reuses them. Node to id is a `WeakMap`. Id to node is a `WeakRef`, with the choice written up in ADR 0010.

Checks that passed: `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build`.

Still open: parts 2–5 (serializer, assets and shadow DOM, privacy, `takeFullSnapshot`). The issue definition of done is not met yet.
